text.arabic_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًۭا

words.gloss_range: terminative particle opening the arrival frame and carrying the journey toward a reached limit
words.prose: {{ar:حَتَّىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ḥattā}}) opens the verse as a terminus, not a loose continuation. Paired with the following scene-opener, it makes the eastern discovery the limit of the route begun in 18:89 and one panel in the repeated journey frame also heard at 18:86 and 18:93.

topics.headline: terminal journey frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse begins at the limit of a journey, so the discovery is framed as arrival rather than a detached report.
topics.reason: The terminative particle and repeated journey formula are locally supported by the temporal clause and same-surah panels at 18:86 and 18:93.

words.gloss_range: temporal scene-opener that turns completed arrival into the discovery event that follows
words.prose: {{ar:إِذَا}} ({{tr:idhā}}) turns the reached endpoint into a timed encounter. Its answer is the discovery verb, so the grammar moves from completed arrival to what was found there, matching the repeated episode-opening rhythm of the journey panels.

topics.headline: arrival converted into encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is the hinge that makes reaching lead directly into discovery.
topics.reason: The particle governs the arrival clause and waits for the following discovery as its answer in the local temporal frame.

words.gloss_range: completed reaching of a concrete endpoint; communicative or maturity branches remain only threshold pressure
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, attaining a limit, maturity, and message-reaching; local grammar selects physical arrival while threshold pressure survives
words.prose: {{ar:بَلَغَ}} ({{tr:balagha}}) presents the arrival as complete before perception begins, with the singular traveler still carried by the verb rather than renamed. Its direct object is the rising-place, so the route tightens into endpoint contact; broader root pressures of reaching a limit, maturity, or message-reaching remain threshold color rather than replacing the local physical arrival.

topics.headline: completed endpoint reaching with narrowed root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the travel process resolve into achieved endpoint contact while broader reaching imagery remains controlled.
topics.reason: Perfect Form I and direct-object grammar select physical arrival, while derivative reaching and communication branches survive only as threshold pressure.

words.gloss_range: sun-defined rising-place, accusative as the reached endpoint; variant and root pressure keep emergence prominent
words.root_gloss_range: rising, emerging, appearing, and looking into; local forms select place and action of solar emergence
words.prose: {{ar:مَطْلِعَ}} ({{tr:maṭliʿa}}) names the endpoint as a sun-defined place of emergence. Its construct bond makes the sun specify the destination, and its accusative object role makes that place what was reached; the variant vowel evidence preserves the same rising-place field, while the later rising verb immediately animates the place-name.

topics.headline: sun-defined emergence-place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is a place defined by the sun rising, not a generic east or independent region.
topics.reason: Construct syntax, object case, noun-of-place morphology, accepted vowel evidence, and the later same-root verb all converge on a reached emergence-place.

words.gloss_range: the definite physical sun as endpoint specifier, pronoun antecedent, and exposure source
words.root_gloss_range: sun and sun-exposure field, with resistant/unmastered pressure secondary; local syntax selects the physical sun
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسِ}} ({{tr:al-shamsi}}) is the known sun that defines the destination and then stays active through the verse. It specifies the rising-place, supplies the feminine suffixes in the discovery and shelter phrase, and contrasts as a definite cosmic body with the unnamed people beneath it.

topics.headline: definite sun as referent chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun remains the tracked referent through destination, discovery, rising, and missing protection.
topics.reason: The construct relation, definiteness, later feminine suffixes, and shelter phrase select the physical sun as the central referent and exposure source.

words.gloss_range: perceptual finding of the sun, with the suffix carrying it into an ongoing visual scene
words.root_gloss_range: finding, perceiving, experiencing, possessing, and existence-related derivation; local frame selects observed discovery
words.prose: {{ar:وَجَدَهَا}} ({{tr:wajadahā}}) is the discovery answer to the arrival frame. The attached suffix carries the sun forward as the object found, and the following circumstantial clause makes the finding visual: he finds it in the act of rising over a people, not as possession, emotion, or causation.

topics.headline: visual discovery pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact pivot from reaching a place to witnessing a condition.
topics.reason: The verb answers the temporal frame, takes the sun suffix as object, and opens into a circumstantial rising clause; other root branches are not selected locally.

words.gloss_range: ongoing intransitive rising of the sun over a people, not informing or causing awareness
words.root_gloss_range: rising, emerging, appearing, and looking into; local form selects ongoing intransitive solar rising
words.prose: {{ar:تَطْلُعُ}} ({{tr:taṭluʿu}}) turns the named rising-place into motion. The feminine imperfect agrees with the sun and makes the rising simultaneous with discovery; with the following over/upon phrase, the motion becomes an overhead encounter with the people, while informing or causative disclosure branches stay outside the local Form I frame.

topics.headline: ongoing rising over the people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sun as an active subject being found mid-rising over a human group.
topics.reason: Feminine singular agreement and imperfect aspect select ongoing solar rising, while the over/upon phrase makes the action bear on the people.

words.gloss_range: over/upon preposition that directs the sunrise onto the people rather than merely locating them nearby
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the small hinge that makes the rising fall over a people. It governs the collective noun and turns the solar motion into an over/upon exposure relation, with adversative pressure felt only because the shelter clause later says no cover was made for them.

topics.headline: over/upon exposure relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition converts sunrise from location into exposure over a human group.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the rising verb and governs the people, selecting an over/upon relation rather than a neutral locative.

words.gloss_range: unnamed collective people positioned under the sunrise and carried forward as deprived recipients
words.root_gloss_range: standing, establishing, station, and peoplehood; local noun names a collective community in a shared exposed position
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:qawmin}}) introduces an unnamed collective under the sun. The word is indefinite and governed by the over/upon phrase, then its referent is carried into the divine non-provision clause through plural pronouns; root pressure of standing and station supports a shared exposed position without turning the word into a location term.

topics.headline: unnamed exposed collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an unnamed community defined by its exposed condition rather than by ethnic or political identity.
topics.reason: Indefiniteness, genitive government by the preposition, and later pronoun tracking make the people an exposed collective and deprived recipient group.

words.gloss_range: past-negating jussive particle governing the shelter-provision clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) opens the explanatory negation. It governs the following jussive verb and converts the clause into past non-provision, so the absence of shelter is stated as something not made for the people rather than a passing lack.

topics.headline: jussive past negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shelterlessness is grammatically framed as completed non-provision.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following verb as jussive and scopes over the final shelter object.

words.gloss_range: divine first-person plural making/provision verb, negated as no shelter made for the people
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, appointing, rendering, and arranging; local valency selects purposeful provision or placement under negation
words.prose: {{ar:نَجْعَلْ}} ({{tr:najʿal}}) carries the speaker shift inside its first-person plural form and keeps the divine agent active rather than hidden in a passive. Under the preceding negator it heads a provision frame: no protective covering was made for the people. The root's making, placing, and arranging range survives as purposeful provision, not accidental scenery.

topics.headline: divine non-provision verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narrative voice turn into divine first-person explanation at the verb itself.
topics.reason: The n-prefix marks first-person plural, the verb is active and jussive under negation, and the clause takes dative recipients plus a shelter object.

words.gloss_range: dative pronoun phrase marking the people as the affected recipients of non-provision
words.prose: {{ar:لَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) keeps the people in the clause before the shelter is named. The lām-plus-pronoun marks them as the affected recipients of the negated making; under negation, the usual for-them relation becomes deprivation rather than benefit.

topics.headline: dative deprived recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are grammatically held as the ones for whom the missing shelter was not made.
topics.reason: The phrase is a dative complement to the making verb, with the suffix referring back to the unnamed people.

words.gloss_range: bound plural pronoun that turns the collective people into human recipients in the provision relation
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) resolves the singular-form collective as a human plural inside the dative phrase. It carries the people across the clause boundary without renaming them and establishes them before the source phrase and final shelter word arrive.

topics.headline: plural pronoun carryover
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the unnamed collective become a specific plural human recipient group in the shelter clause.
topics.reason: The bound masculine plural pronoun refers back to the collective people and remains attached to the dative relation.

words.gloss_range: source/protection-from preposition beginning the phrase that orients the absent shelter against the sun
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) begins the source/protection phrase before the shelter noun appears. It makes the absent cover directional: the missing protection would stand from or against the sun-side relation named by the following word, so the final shelter is already oriented before it is spoken.

topics.headline: source and protection-from relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shelterlessness has direction: it is lack of protection from the sun, not generic lack of cover.
topics.reason: The preposition starts the phrase attached to the shelter/provision relation and gives source or protection-from force.

topics.headline: minor nasal binding note
topics.reason: The sound note repeats the compound-relation payoff already carried by the retained topic.

words.gloss_range: sun-tethered relational noun in a source phrase, selecting below/before/against shielding geometry
words.root_gloss_range: below, before, apart from, short of, and related register/documentation derivatives; local phrase selects spatial protective relation
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِهَا}} ({{tr:dūnihā}}) anchors the missing shelter to the sun with a relational noun and suffix. In the source phrase, it gives the geometry of exposure: below, before, or against the sun with no intervening screen. Documentation-register derivatives are not locally licensed; the active payoff is spatial protective relation.

topics.headline: sun-directed shielding geometry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a precise geometry of exposure: the absent shield would have stood in relation to the sun.
topics.reason: The word is governed by the source preposition, bound to the sun by suffix, and locally qualifies the shelter relation; broader non-spatial derivatives are not selected.

topics.headline: documentation derivative as local meaning
topics.blocking_evidence: Documentation derivatives are not licensed by the local source phrase, suffix reference, or shelter object.
topics.reason: The local construction selects a spatial protective relation with the sun; documentation or registry language would replace the selected relation with an unrelated derivative branch.

words.gloss_range: indefinite protective covering or screen denied as the final object; not a specified device only
words.root_gloss_range: covering, screening, concealing, and interposing a barrier; local object selects protective shelter against exposure
words.prose: {{ar:سِتْرًا}} ({{tr:sitran}}) is the final object the clause has been waiting for. It is indefinite under negation, so the denial reaches any qualifying protective cover, and its verbal-noun form keeps the category functional rather than tied to one device. The rare root and final position make the verse land on total exposure, while theological mercy language would overstate what the local word itself says.

topics.headline: indefinite final cover denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun denies any relevant protective screen and makes the verse culminate on exposed shelterlessness.
topics.reason: The object is accusative under the making verb, indefinite under negation, qualified by the source phrase, and placed at the verse end.

topics.headline: divine attribute reading as local claim
topics.blocking_evidence: The local object names a protective cover in a negated provision clause; a theological attribute claim goes beyond the licensed local evidence.
topics.reason: The shelter object can carry covering and concealment pressure, but the claim of absence of divine concealing mercy is not entailed by the local grammar.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence balagha / matla'a al-shams / tatlu'u ala qawmin / sitran binds travel-limit, solar emergence, people, and absent cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival at a terminal solar locus becomes a geometry of direct incidence: the sun emerges onto the people with no near-side layer interrupting it.

activation_trace.role: Endpoint-reaching fixes the encounter at a travel limit where the exposure becomes legible.
The luminary's rising and its locus supply the emergence that bears directly on the people.
Solar disk, light, and sunlit day provide the physical agent of exposure.
A near side short of the endpoint supplies the position where an intervening buffer is missing.
Covering names the absent physical layer that would break direct solar contact.

changed_reading.before: A traveler reaches an eastern place and sees people without shade.
changed_reading.after: The ayah composes an endpoint geometry in which solar emergence reaches a community without any intervening layer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled tala'a, wajadaha, and the negated sitr join appearance, discovery, and non-concealment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same scene that exposes bodies to light also exposes a collective to finding: emergence and discovery converge, while divine making assigns them no concealment.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and looking into an affair turn solar appearance into an image of unveiled legibility.
Finding by sense or intellect makes the exposed condition an encountered and apprehended one.
The found object is a human collective, so exposure is social rather than merely topographic.
Making something into a condition frames lack of concealment as an assigned state.
Covering and hiding provide the expressly negated condition.

changed_reading.before: The people happen to be visible because their land has no shelter.
changed_reading.after: Appearance, finding, and negated concealment stage a collective whose exposed condition is itself the object of encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The empowered traveler receives comprehensive means, including latent images of connection and shelter, while the people are expressly not made a screen; exposure becomes an asymmetry of provision rather than a bare climatic datum.

activation_trace.role: Making or bringing forth anchors the explicit non-production of the people's screen.
Covering identifies what is absent from their material condition.
Empowerment supplies the traveler's broad capacity against which the people's lack is measured.
A canopy or dwelling is a latent shelter image inside the comprehensive grant, sharpening the distributional contrast.
A rope or connection renders the granted means as usable mediation across distance.

structural_cues: 18:84 grants enablement and means in first-person plural; 18:90 repeats first-person plural in a negated making.
Repeated sabab-following carries the empowered traveler to the encounter, but 18:90 narrates no remedial act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies empowerment, comprehensive means, a canopy image, and an unmade screen; I infer a contrast in access to mediation. A live alternative is that the negation describes only local ecology and implies no distributive claim.

changed_reading.before: The people lack naturally available shade.
changed_reading.after: Their unshielded condition stands beside concentrated mobility and means, exposing an asymmetry of access without stating that the traveler must repair it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The western sun is perceived within a water-medium and a people are found beside it; the eastern sun rises upon a people with no screen. The paired endpoint reverses who or what receives the solar event.

activation_trace.role: Solar rising supplies the eastern pole of the paired horizon mechanism.
The absent cover removes any medium between the eastern people and the solar event.
Sunset and west supply the inverse horizon motion and locus.
A flowing spring supplies the western containing medium that the eastern scene lacks.

structural_cues: 18:86 and 18:90 repeat the arrival, solar locus, finding, solar verb, and people sequence.
The west places the perceived sun in a spring and the people beside it; the east places the rising directly upon the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight syntactic mirror plus water-medium versus absent screen; I infer a reversal in the distribution of mediation. The alternative is a purely perspectival geography with no causal force in the prepositions.

changed_reading.before: East and west are equivalent itinerary endpoints distinguished only by sunset and sunrise.
changed_reading.after: The west embeds the solar appearance in a medium, while the east makes the people themselves the unbuffered receiving surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after bodily non-enclosure, complete divine knowledge encloses what is with the traveler; physical exposure is nested inside epistemic circumference rather than equated with abandonment.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and inspection make the focus scene available to an epistemic reading.
Negated covering supplies the inner, physically unenclosed condition.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies an outer epistemic boundary around the exposed scene.
Knowledge of report and interior reality prevents enclosure from being reduced to visual observation.

structural_cues: 18:91 immediately follows the no-screen clause with comprehensive knowledge of what was with him.
The sequence moves from visible exterior exposure to knowledge of interior circumstance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent cover followed by complete knowledgeable encompassing; I infer nested containment. The alternative is that 18:91 closes only the traveler's biography and does not characterize the people.

changed_reading.before: No shelter leaves the people simply outside protection.
changed_reading.after: They are unbuffered from the sun yet the whole encounter remains inside a complete, interior-reaching field of knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later community converts an interstitial gap into a filled, iron barrier through request and labor. That successful manufacture retroactively distinguishes the eastern screen as an absent infrastructure, not only absent vegetation.

activation_trace.role: Making anchors the question of whether a protective object is brought into existence.
Covering supplies the protective function left unrealized at the eastern endpoint.
The middle space between two sides supplies the site in which mediation can be built.
Filling a breach and separating two sides gives the later screen its barrier logic.
Closing a gap turns protection into deliberate construction.
Iron and resistant solidity supply the material basis of manufactured cover.

structural_cues: 18:93-96 proceeds from a community's request through assistance, placement, filling, and material transformation.
18:97 tests the product by attempted scaling and piercing, confirming protection as a functional interface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gap, barrier, breach-filling, and iron solidity; I read the later construction as a retroactive contrast for the unmade screen. The alternative is that defense from agents and shelter from sun are unrelated obstacle types.

changed_reading.before: Sitr denotes whatever natural shade the eastern land lacks.
changed_reading.after: Sitr also marks a missing protective infrastructure whose manufacturability the later barrier episode demonstrates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later barrier first defeats ascent and penetration, then is promised leveling. The sequence places the eastern absence of cover beside a maximal but temporary cover, denying ultimacy to either exposure or engineering.

activation_trace.role: The absent covering supplies one limit case of mediation.
Capacity and inability certify the barrier's present effectiveness against both attacks.
Piercing through to what lies beyond supplies the penetration the barrier presently blocks.
A promise fixed to a future time places the successful cover under a temporal limit.
Demolition to level ground supplies the eventual removal of constructed mediation.

structural_cues: 18:97 gives the barrier double practical success; 18:98 immediately subjects it to a promised future.
The focus screen is absent from the start, whereas the later barrier passes from construction to efficacy to leveling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an effective barrier and its promised demolition; I infer that the sequence relativizes every cover. The alternative is that the promise concerns only this named barrier and should not feed back into the solar scene.

changed_reading.before: The eastern people uniquely lack a protection that other communities can possess securely.
changed_reading.after: Their no-cover condition sits within a sequence where even the strongest made cover is effective only provisionally.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a utensil-and-fire branch under ja'ala rather than the ordinary verb sense. It remains anchored in the negated making of a sitr and is reinforced by the later controlled fire and molten metal sequence; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not as a lexical replacement for ja'ala.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Naj'ala ... sitran can carry, at branch distance, the image of a fabricated heat-handling layer precisely where the sun's heat is unmediated.

activation_trace.role: A cloth used to lower a pot and ward off heat supplies a literal thermal interface to the negated making.
Covering keeps the thermal analogy attached to the absent screen.
Sending air into matter supplies controlled intensification of heat.
Kindled fire supplies the heat that later becomes an engineering input.
Molten copper supplies the transformed hot material that seals the barrier.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a lack of shade against environmental heat.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it marks absence of a thermal interface; later, air, fire, and molten metal show heat converted from exposure into protective work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts sitr from physical screen to interpersonal mediation. It remains branch-backed and anchored by duniha plus the later between/barrier, payment, and assistance sequence; downstream prose should call it a social-structural analogy, not claim that sitr straightforwardly means ruler in 18:90.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Min duniha sitran leaves no intervening protector between a community and an overwhelming force.

activation_trace.role: An intermediary between persons supplies a social rather than merely material screen.
The near intervening position locates where such brokerage would stand.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the relational site of mediation.
A specified financial contribution makes later protection a negotiated social arrangement.
Mutual assistance supplies the collective participation through which mediation is realized.
The filled gap materializes the brokered protection as infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: The community has no object casting shade.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no mediating institution stands between community and force; the later episode externalizes such mediation as negotiated collective infrastructure.

strongest_changes: The west/east mirror changes two itinerary notices into opposite regimes of mediation: a solar appearance in a medium versus a people directly under it.
The immediate move from no physical enclosure to complete knowledgeable enclosure nests exposure inside epistemic containment.
The later barrier turns sitr into an infrastructural question and then limits every constructed protection by its promised leveling.
summary.what_was_special: The sequence lets one absent screen activate several distinct interfaces: optical, spatial, epistemic, infrastructural, thermal, and social, without collapsing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether lam naj'al marks intentional non-provision or only describes local created conditions.
How strongly the later defensive barrier should retroactively govern a solar-exposure scene.
The canopy, heat-cloth, and interpersonal-sitr activations are branch-backed but deliberately form-distant and must remain qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Lack of cover is an assigned environmental state.** `ج ع ل` B002 (“turning something into a state”) is negated for any shelter between the people and sun. This contrasts with the cave’s carefully moderated sunlight (18:17) and the barrier people’s constructed protection (18:93–97). I infer that human settings differ in exposure by divine arrangement; one policy cannot be read directly from geography alone. The ayah widens the surah’s ecology of protection.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:98 corrected any inference that absence or presence of shelter guarantees permanence; every protection remains assigned.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Natural exposure activates the need for mediated protection.** `س ت ر/B001` is covering and concealment; `س ت ر/B005` is an intermediary between people. The fixed people have no cover between themselves and the sun; 18:93–95 then encounters another people who seek an engineered barrier between themselves and a threat. I infer that `مِن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا` identifies absence of mediation, not simply lack of fabric or building. The ayah reads as a limit-case of direct exposure that prepares the later social technology of shielding.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:93–95 supplied the surprise: a later people explicitly seek the protective intermediary absent from the sun-exposed people here.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bakıp öğrenme, başkasına gösterip bildirme, başı görünür kılma ve birinin görüşünü yoklama işlemlerini aynı dalda verir. Bunlar tek bir katılımcı düzenine indirgenemeyeceği için dal, görünür veya bilinir kılma ortaklığı korunarak ve katılımcı değişimleri açıkça ayrılarak kabul edilebilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen bakma, öğrenme, gösterme ve görüş yoklama kuruluşlarına bağlıdır; genel bilgi edinme ya da açıklama anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye bakarak onun iç yüzünü öğrenmek veya onu başkasına görünür ya da bilinir kılmaktır; birinin görüşünü araştırma ve başı dışarı çıkarıp gösterme de bu kuruluşlara bağlı özel işlemlerdir.

facets.statement: Gözlemleyen kişi bir şeye yukarıdan bakar ya da iç yüzüne erişerek onu bütünüyle öğrenir.
Bilgiyi bilen kişi, bir işi veya saklı sözü başkasına göstererek onun da bilmesini sağlar.
Bir kişinin başını dışarı çıkarıp görünür kılması, fiziksel gösterme alt kullanımını oluşturur.
Birinin ne düşündüğünü anlamak için görüşünü araştırmak, bilgi edinme işleminin özel bir uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar bir şeyi gözleyip iç yüzünü öğrenme ile bilinen şeyi başkasına gösterip bildirme yönlerini birlikte verir. Başı görünür kılma, bir metni inceleme ve birinin görüşünü yoklama bu ortak görünürlük ve bilgi edinme düzeninin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
